premises.text: Businesses currently lack a single platform for all telecommunications services.
premises.evidence_span: there hasn't been a single platform where you can actually get all of your telecommunications services from the same system until today.

premises.text: Current mobile devices provided by companies do not have business features.
premises.evidence_span: that is not an actual business phone. It is just a cell phone. It doesn't do extension dialing. It doesn't do call recording.

premises.text: Integrating mobile devices with the Switch allows for seamless call transfers and business features.
premises.evidence_span: utilizing the Sprint network, we have been able to integrate mobile with our Switch directly.

premises.text: The system allows for real-time tracking and call recording regardless of the device used.
premises.evidence_span: we can track it over the wireless network. You can use extension dialing. And we can even record all of your calls.

premises.text: Private telecom networks are important for security-sensitive organizations.
premises.evidence_span: the government is one thing that likes to have a private telecom network. Military, hospitals, banks.

premises.text: International calls through the system are significantly cheaper than traditional carriers.
premises.evidence_span: international calls or IP are significantly cheaper.
